githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.6 Beta 3 adds server joining, native invite cards, server onboarding, Server Guide, Channels & Roles, and pinned direct messages. It also improves Japanese text input, thread history, emoji pickers, and sidebar transitions.

## Server joining and onboarding

- Added server joining from invite links or codes, with native previews and interactive invite cards in messages.
- Added support for completing hCaptcha challenges when joining a server.
- Added Leave Server to the server menu for members who do not own the server.
- Added native server onboarding with welcome screens, required questions, and channel and role choices.
- Preserved onboarding answers and the current question when navigating away and returning.

## Server Guide and channel customization

- Added Server Guide with welcome messages, new-member tasks, progress tracking, and readable resource pages.
- Added Channels & Roles for updating server customization answers and viewing assigned roles.
- Added channel browsing, search, previews, individual channel selection, category following, and Show All Channels.
- Added a Channel customization setting to show all channels and hide customization controls while preserving saved server selections.

## Direct messages

- Added pinning for DMs and group DMs, keeping pinned conversations above other conversations and synchronizing pin changes with Discord.
- Added individual unread conversations to the server rail for direct access.
- Added avatars and presence indicators to the DM toolbar, with combined participant avatars for group DMs without a custom icon.

## Messaging and media

- Fixed Japanese IME text disappearing during composition and prevented unfinished composition from carrying into another conversation.
- Fixed thread history preservation when switching conversations and loading older messages, including gaps in forum post history.
- Added native macOS dictionary lookup for message text while keeping hidden spoilers concealed.
- Added sent dates to message header timestamps.
- Fixed website previews that use Discord’s component-based embeds.
- Fixed media viewer dismissal to animate back to the selected gallery photo.

## Pickers, profiles, and navigation

- Improved emoji, sticker, and soundboard picker layouts, selection fields, composer contrast, and scrolling in long drafts.
- Added source server names and icons to the emoji picker footer and hid servers without usable emojis.
- Changed animated profile pictures to play on hover.
- Improved custom status display alongside listening activity and added support for emoji-only status bubbles.
- Added animated member and DM profile sidebars while preserving the message reading position as the layout changes.
- Fixed an accessibility crash when reopening a DM profile and refreshed member name colors when switching appearance.
- Reorganized menu commands to group view controls and conversation navigation more clearly.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6-Beta-2...v0.1.6-Beta-3](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6-Beta-2...v0.1.6-Beta-3)
discordAnnouncement:
**Server joining, onboarding, and pinned DMs 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Join servers from invite links or native invite cards, complete supported CAPTCHA challenges, and leave servers from the server menu.
- Complete server onboarding and revisit your choices in Channels & Roles.
- Explore Server Guide tasks and resources, browse channels, and choose which channels or categories appear in your list.
- Pin DMs and group DMs above other conversations, and open unread conversations directly from the server rail.
- Japanese typing and thread history fixes, plus native macOS dictionary lookup in messages.
- Refined emoji pickers with source server names, animated sidebars that preserve your reading position, and corrected gallery closing animations.
